The target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:39] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 2} on a critical failure).

291km5v3jjb679dn.name: Shadow Snip
291km5v3jjb679dn.description:
Frequency three times per day

Effect Tatterthread produces a scrap of shadow linked to the fate of a creature within 100 feet of her, then snips it with her caustic shears. The target takes @Damage[100[acid]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:42|basic]). If the target is reduced to 0 Hit Points from this damage, it melts into a puddle of fetid acid and dies immediately. If the target failed the saving throw, it loses any acid resistance it has for 1 minute (1 day on a critical failure). A creature slain by Shadow Snip can't be restored to life except by miracle, wish, or similarly powerful magic, or by divine intervention. Regardless of the outcome of its save, a creature targeted by Shadow Snip becomes temporarily immune for 24 hours. The norn can't use Shadow Snip again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Shadow Snip]]{1d4 rounds}.

2uz3cp2ye4ku791n.name: Shift Fate
2uz3cp2ye4ku791n.description:
Trigger A creature within 120 feet attempts a saving throw

Effect The creature rolls the save twice, and then Tatterthread decides which result applies. If she chooses the lower roll, this is a misfortune effect; if she chooses the higher roll, it's a fortune effect; if they're the same, she decides which trait to apply.

Aspect of Immortality.name: Aspect of Immortality
Aspect of Immortality.description:
The Grim Reaper is the unflinching personification of death. Silent as the grave and as inevitable as time itself, this legendary being hunts down and finishes creatures that have evaded death for far too long. Sometimes the Grim Reaper comes without warning, while at others it comes to finish the work that other creatures could not. The Grim Reaper serves no god, fiend, or aeon. It is both despised and feared by psychopomps and celestials, but few-if any-dare to stand in its way. Like some eternal plague, it kills those who try to cure the multiverse of its presence. It stands alone and holds only its own council, and the pleading and reasoning of mortals and immortals alike fall on deaf ears once the Grim Reaper closes on its quarry. Its own reasoning is silent to mortal ears and inscrutable to the mortal mind, but no matter the reason, the result is unyielding and final.

While some legends hold that the Grim Reaper appears before everyone as they die, the truth is quite a bit more disturbing. Such vigils in fact lie within the providence of the psychopomps, a race of immortals charged with the protection and guidance of mortal souls through the afterlife. The Grim Reaper has little interest in protecting souls or guiding them. It is instead compelled by sinister agendas arising within the nighted realm of Abaddon, where the Horsemen of the Apocalypse rule. Indeed there are many similarities in shape and form between the Grim Reaper and Charon, the Horseman of Death, but no recorded instance exists of these two powerful entities working together. Instead, the Grim Reaper serves as something of a manifestation of Abaddon itself, and in this regard is believed by some to be an incarnation of the mysterious First Horseman. When the Grim Reaper comes to a world, it does so not as an angel of mercy, but as a relentless harvester of life. Those who fall to the Grim Reaper were not destined to die as much as they were selected, hunted, and murdered.

Perhaps the most frightening legends surrounding the Grim Reaper concern its nature as a singular entity, for some believe that more than one grim reaper exists in the Great Beyond. These whispers tell of a cabal of at least nine of these creatures that stalk reality, culling the living as inexplicable servants of true entropy. According to the teaching of some death cults, the final goal of the Grim Reaper is to end the entire cycle of life and death and serve as a silent lord of an empty universe.

1nw27q1yzi9jiohx.name: Quickened
1nw27q1yzi9jiohx.description: You gain 1 additional action at the start of your turn each round. Many effects that make you quickened specify the types of actions you can use with this additional action. If you become quickened from multiple sources, you can use the extra action you've been granted for any single action allowed by any of the effects that made you quickened. Because quickened has its effect at the start of your turn, you don't immediately gain actions if you become quickened during your turn.

xDzg2v4rQ9wNAK3b.name: Death's Grace
xDzg2v4rQ9wNAK3b.description: The Aspect of Immortality can choose whether or not it counts as undead for effects that affect undead differently. Even if it does not count as undead, the Aspect of Immortality still never counts as a living creature.

SWo4EQT4exBUG1zV.name: Status Sight
SWo4EQT4exBUG1zV.description: The Aspect of Immortality automatically knows the Hit Points, conditions, afflictions, and emotions of all creatures it can see.

dWgrFKYnx0FM8zl3.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

6aClhFTvO5NOf1iA.name: Aura of Misfortune
6aClhFTvO5NOf1iA.description:
20 feet. Living creatures in the aura must roll twice on all d20 rolls and use the lower result.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.QoneHsjZKtGHWlam]{Effect: Aura of Misfortune}

skqRE7JS8Ge3jlfR.name: Key Weakness
skqRE7JS8Ge3jlfR.description: Jatembe's history of vanquishing the King of Biting Ants survives in the halcyon legacy of the Magaambya. The Aspect of Immortality has a key weakness to both arcane spells and primal spells.

ei3nQVCq6MHIPrMy.name: Lurking Death
ei3nQVCq6MHIPrMy.description:
Trigger A creature within 100 feet makes a ranged attack or uses an action that has the concentrate, manipulate, or move trait.

Effect The Aspect of Immortality teleports to a square adjacent to the triggering creature and makes a melee Strike against it. If the Strike hits, the Aspect of Immortality disrupts the triggering action.

YMwe0HIrPrtpRdsx.name: Void Healing

The Aspect of Immortality can choose whether or not it takes vitality damage.

TzBbRiqiSDZj6VdK.name: Death Strike
TzBbRiqiSDZj6VdK.description: A creature critically hit by any of the Aspect of Immortality's attacks or that critically fails against any of its spells must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:47] save or die.

W3a4Bkc73B2bUZDE.name: Energy Drain
W3a4Bkc73B2bUZDE.description: When the Aspect of Immortality hits and deals damage with its scythe, it regains @Damage[20[healing]] Hit Points, and the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:43] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}. If the target is already doomed, the doomed value increases by 1 (to a maximum of doomed 3).

Zp7ozjV5uBLnBo41.name: Final Death
Zp7ozjV5uBLnBo41.description: A creature killed by the Aspect of Immortality can't be brought back to life by any means short of divine intervention.

0qVGuAvlfZ7EplZ5.name: Infuse Weapon
0qVGuAvlfZ7EplZ5.description: Any scythe gains the agile trait, can't be disarmed, and becomes a +3 Major Striking Keen scythe while the Aspect of Immortality wields it. If the Aspect of Immortality Strikes a creature with a weakness to any specific type of damage, the scythe's damage counts as that type of damage, in addition to slashing.

xfqu4h4qvq9m5jap.name: Shadow's Displeasure
xfqu4h4qvq9m5jap.description: When Okoro has fewer than 150 Hit Points, his shadow pulls at his essence to show the Vesicant Egg's displeasure. He looks pained and confused, and he becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until healed to 150 Hit Points or more. These conditions increase to 2 when below 100 Hit Points. When below 50 Hit Points, he falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.

rt2r6pmpylk7004h.name: Vesicated Shadow
rt2r6pmpylk7004h.description: Okoro's shadow has become corrupted via the power of the Vesicant Egg. His shredded shadow grants him some control over acid and shadows. He gains a +4 status bonus to resist acid and shadow effects.

jvm0dsaowmfz1zgn.name: Observe Weakness
jvm0dsaowmfz1zgn.description: Okoro studies a creature within 30 feet to find an opening to attack. On his next attack roll against the creature this turn, he rolls twice and uses the higher result, and his attack gains the fortune trait. The target becomes temporarily immune for [[/r 1d4 #Observe Weakness Immunity]]{1d4 rounds}.

mds3qf6b45mnbotm.name: Rupture Shadow
mds3qf6b45mnbotm.description:
Okoro can create immense blisters on a creature's shadow, which immediately burst, dealing @Damage[20d6[acid]] damage. He targets a creature within 60 feet that is casting a shadow, which must attempt a @Check[will|dc:37] save. Okoro can't use Rupture Shadow again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Rupture Shadow]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune for 1 day.

Success The target takes half damage. The bursting shadow deals @Damage[(5[splash])[acid]]{5 acid splash} damage to all creatures within 5 feet of the target.

Failure The target takes full damage, and the bursting shadow deals @Damage[(10[splash])[acid]]{10 acid splash} damage.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, the bursting shadow deals @Damage[(20[splash])[acid]]{20 acid splash} damage, and the target also takes @Damage[4d6[persistent,acid]] damage.

1hjoyx9fc8r2v9tx.name: Push My Luck
1hjoyx9fc8r2v9tx.description:
Trigger Okoro targets a creature with an attack

Requirements The triggering creature was the target of Observe Weakness this turn

Effect Okoro draws upon his future luck to guarantee his attack. When he makes his attack roll, if he rolls lower than 10 on the die, he treats that attack roll as a 10 instead. This is in addition to rolling twice and taking the higher result from Observe Weakness. Afterward, Okoro's luck is temporarily spent, and he must roll twice and use the lower result of his next 3 checks; this is a misfortune effect. He can't use Push My Luck again until he's completed these 3 checks.

Qgr6aPoWv3z40lCF.name: Claim Trophy
Qgr6aPoWv3z40lCF.description: Shianshi claims the soul of a creature she killed within the last minute. This works like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYmXvS9NJ7QwfWGg]{Seize Soul}, except that no black sapphire is required and the soul is turned into a glowing blue light called a soul trophy. Anyone who kills Shianshi can then free the soul from any soul trophy by touching it and speaking the word for "freedom" in any language.

cygg7o7z0toswl57.name: Huntblade Brutality
cygg7o7z0toswl57.description: Shianshi's greatsword Strikes have the death trait and deal an additional 2d8 damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} creatures.

2ydazja8ihmn5gye.name: Hunter's Leap
2ydazja8ihmn5gye.description:
Trigger Shianshi kills a creature

Effect Shianshi teleports up to 30 feet and makes a greatsword Strike; on a hit, the target of the Strike is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} on a critical hit).

y9l0m6fta3rgdp17.name: Whip Drain
y9l0m6fta3rgdp17.description:
Requirements Shianshi has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} with her shadow whip

Effect The grabbed creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:41] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3} on a critical failure). If the creature is already drained, this increases its drained value instead, to a maximum of drained 4.

Slana.name: Slana
Slana.description: The rolling thunder before the rain provides the massive, leonine humanoids known as slanas with a tremendous power. These solitary and nomadic creatures primarily dwell in the jungles and savannas of the Mwangi Expanse, but they can range into nearby areas in search of prey or when drawn by strange primal forces only slanas can recognize. Slanas view each other as rivals who test each other's prowess, so when drawn together by this strange calling they nearly always fight to the death. A slana's roar echoes like thunder across the countryside, and denizens of the Mwangi fear a slana's approach whenever an oncoming storm's thunder seems more ferocious than its rain.

g1jzrlcfjodmehjj.name: Great Roar
g1jzrlcfjodmehjj.description: The slana emits a deafening roar. All creatures within a @Template[cone|distance:100] take @Damage[16d8[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:44|basic|options:area-effect] saving throw). On a failed save, a creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 minute and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} (or deafened permanently and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3} on a critical failure). The slana can't use Great Roar again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Great Roar]]{1d4 rounds}.

jf7pxx8ohd0mik4h.name: Pounce
jf7pxx8ohd0mik4h.description: The slana Strides and makes a Strike at the end of that movement. If the slana began this action @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, they remain hidden until after the ability's Strike.

kxvgkv6jremvktxm.name: Thunder Trap
kxvgkv6jremvktxm.description: A creature hit by the slana's thunderclap attack is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and held in place by reverberations of sound until it Escapes or Forces Open the bonds of thunder that constrain it (DC 44). The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} as long as it is immobilized by a thunder trap.

Clockwork Clock Tower.name: Clockwork Clock Tower
Clockwork Clock Tower.description: Clockworks are machines built by engineers and augmented with magic. A clock tower reconfigured as an animated clockwork can rotate slices of time.

D5fap6jAbrTYxRzC.name: Wind-Up
D5fap6jAbrTYxRzC.description:
1 week [[/act disable-device dc=40]]{DC 40 Thievery}

For a clockwork to act, it must be wound with a unique key by another creature. This takes 1 minute. Once wound, it remains operational for the listed amount of time, usually 24 hours, after which time it becomes unaware of its surroundings and can't act until it's wound again. Some clockworks' abilities require them to spend some of their remaining operational time. They can't spend more than they have and shut down immediately once they have 0 time remaining. If it's unclear when a clockwork was last wound, most clockwork keepers wind all their clockworks at a set time, typically 8 a.m.

A clockwork that lists standby in its wind-up entry can enter standby mode as a 3-action activity. Its operational time doesn't decrease in standby, but it can sense its surroundings (with a -2 penalty to Perception). It can't act, with one exception: when it perceives a creature, it can exit standby as a reaction (rolling initiative if appropriate).

A creature can attempt to Disable a Device to wind a clockwork down (with a DC listed in the wind-up entry). For each success, the clockwork loses 1 hour of operational time. This can be done even if the clockwork is in standby mode.

yaqehvxmvhkp5fxd.name: Doleful Tolling
yaqehvxmvhkp5fxd.description:
Trigger The clockwork clock tower rolls initiative

Effect The clock tower chimes, and all non-clockwork creatures within 300 feet who can hear it must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:42|options:inflicts:slowed] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} on a critical failure).

9v8rq139qt9yru0f.name: Durable Exterior
9v8rq139qt9yru0f.description: When a clockwork clock tower is reduced to fewer than 200 HP or is damaged by a critical hit, its exterior shatters to reveal internal mechanisms, reducing its AC to 44 until it recovers enough HP to reach 200 HP or more.

de6tbnvg9wd9cn40.name: Overclock
de6tbnvg9wd9cn40.description: The clockwork clock tower loses 1 day from its winding time and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 3 rounds. It can use this extra action to Step, Stride, or Strike. This quickened condition ends immediately if the clock tower is damaged by orichalcum.

muwh6r24icy88fbd.name: Stutter Time
muwh6r24icy88fbd.description:
A creature struck by a clockwork clock tower's fist must make a @Check[will|dc:40] save as time flows unevenly around it.

Critical Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 1 round and can use this extra action to Step, Stride, or Strike.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3}.

Critical Failure The creature is knocked out of time, which ceases to flow around the creature for 1 round. It is invulnerable to all damage, it can't be targeted or affected by anything, and no rounds elapse for any timed durations, conditions, afflictions, and other effects it has. The target can't act and remains fixed in place, defying gravity if applicable. After time begins to flow again for it, the creature is stunned 3.

hEpxe1FfIjVaqxj4.name: Shadow's Displeasure
hEpxe1FfIjVaqxj4.description: When Haibam has fewer than 150 Hit Points, his shadow pulls at his essence to show the Vesicant Egg's displeasure. He looks pained and confused, and he becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until healed to 150 Hit Points or more. These conditions increase to 2 when below 100 Hit Points. When below 50 Hit Points, he falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.

skiRGL9UQGWGEdSZ.name: Vesicated Shadow
skiRGL9UQGWGEdSZ.description: Haibam's shadow has become corrupted via the power of the Vesicant Egg. His shredded shadow grants him some control over acid and shadows. He gains a +4 status bonus to resist acid and shadow effects.

8cIoZgJYjTSQNeqn.name: Rupture Shadow
8cIoZgJYjTSQNeqn.description:
Haibam can create immense blisters on a creature's shadow, which immediately burst, dealing @Damage[20d6[acid]] damage. He targets a creature within 60 feet that is casting a shadow, which must attempt a @Check[will|dc:37] save. Haibam can't use Rupture Shadow again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Rupture Shadow]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune for 1 day.

Success The target takes half damage. The bursting shadow deals @Damage[(5[splash])[acid]]{5 acid splash} damage to all creatures within 5 feet of the target.

Failure The target takes full damage, and the bursting shadow deals @Damage[(10[splash])[acid]]{10 acid splash} damage.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, the bursting shadow deals @Damage[(20[splash])[acid]]{20 acid splash} damage, and the target also takes @Damage[4d6[persistent,acid]] damage.

smorxcoe1pndxktg.name: Wind Step
smorxcoe1pndxktg.description: Haibram draws air around him to aid his movement. He Strides up to his Speed, gaining the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.b5sGjGlBf58f8jn0]{Air Walk} and ignoring difficult terrain while moving. He can increase the number of actions to 3 to Stride up to three times his Speed instead. Haibram begins to fall immediately after using Wind Step but treats the fall as 60 feet shorter thanks to the supporting winds.

g9ab3molowrdwii3.name: Wind Touch
g9ab3molowrdwii3.description: Haibram imbues a weapon he's holding with the power of the wind until the start of his next turn. The wind's power allows Haibram to swing and hurl the weapon with great force, causing the weapon to deal an additional 2d10 damage. If the weapon does not have the thrown trait, it also gains the thrown 10 feet trait during this attack.

3id1at0ia52fnd21.name: Bombardier's Spray
3id1at0ia52fnd21.description: The cataclysm beetle sprays a @Template[cone|distance:60] of acid from its abdomen that deals @Damage[12d10[acid]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic|options:area-effect]). It can't use Bombardier's Spray or Burning Pool for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Bombardier's Spray]]{1d4 rounds}.

mcdudgr7o0sytxln.name: Burning Pool
mcdudgr7o0sytxln.description: The cataclysm beetle spills acid directly from its abdomen, creating a wave of acid that deals @Damage[10d12[acid]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:30] (@Check[fortitude|dc:40|basic|options:area-effect]). Creatures that fail this save are pushed back 10 feet from the cataclysm beetle (30 feet on a critical failure). It can't use Bombardier's Spray or Burning Pool for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Acid Action]]{1d4 rounds}.

b8m3301u6voc54xx.name: Axe Vulnerability
b8m3301u6voc54xx.description: The hivebound arboreal takes 15 additional from axes.

imdm1852t7fcgfad.name: Swarm Host
imdm1852t7fcgfad.description: 20 feet. The hivebound arboreal is host to a cloud of flying ants that swarm around it and gnaw at any creature within the aura. Non-arboreal creatures that enter the aura or start their turn within it take @Damage[7d8[piercing]] damage from the bites (@Check[fortitude|dc:38|basic]). If the hivebound arboreal fails a saving throw against an area effect, the biting ants die off, and the aura is deactivated until new ants swarm out at the end of the hivebound arboreal's next turn (or after 1 minute, if the hivebound arboreal critically fails it saving throw).

bqm225yruvrtoqii.name: Offered to the Swarm
bqm225yruvrtoqii.description:
Trigger The arboreal Grabs or Constricts a foe

Requirements The hivebound arboreal's swarm host is active

Effect The arboreal offers up the triggering creature to its ants to feed. The triggering creature takes damage as from the swarm host aura, but thereafter gains a +4 circumstance bonus to Escape the Grab until it Escapes.

Venom Pool.name: Venom Pool
Venom Pool.desc (hazard): A shallow, foul-smelling puddle of toxic acid blocks a narrow hall (marked with a dotted line on the map), and poison bursts from it when disturbed.
Venom Pool.disable: @Check[crafting|dc:40|name:Neutralize the acid|traits:hazard,complex,environmental] (master) or @Check[survival|dc:42|name:Neutralize the acid|traits:hazard,complex,environmental] (legendary) to neutralize the acid while within reach of it. Three successes using either skill (or a combination of both) destroys the hazard.
Venom Pool.reset: The hazard ends after 1 minute, contracting to its original size and keeping still until disturbed again.
Venom Pool.routine: (2 actions) The hazard uses its first action to spread 10 feet down the hallway in both directions. Once out of the hall, each side spreads in a random direction each round, but they don't go through doors. The hazard uses its second action to move the center of the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MlpbeZ61Euhl0d60]{Toxic Cloud} up to 20 feet in any direction to which any part of the pool has line of effect (normally, to encompass the greatest number of characters). If the cloudkill isn't present, it instead uses its second action to produce a new cloudkill, as Poison Puff.
Venom Pool.stealth: (legendary) to distinguish between the hazard and the oozes within it; @Check[perception|dc:0|traits:hazard,complex,environmental] to notice the pool

d8um494r4xk6f98a.name: Deadly Footing
d8um494r4xk6f98a.description: The area of the venom pool is difficult terrain, and each creature moving through it takes @Damage[10[acid]]{10 acid} for every square of its area that it moves into.

pdwzupwod8pa2gwn.name: Poison Puff
pdwzupwod8pa2gwn.description:
Trigger A creature moves through any square in the hazard's space

Effect The pool produces a 9th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MlpbeZ61Euhl0d60]{Toxic Cloud}; (@Check[fortitude|dc:40|traits:death,necromancy,poison]) at its center. It then rolls initiative.

yyukj2oty9v0t7d4.name: Lead by Example
yyukj2oty9v0t7d4.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect The Red Queen Strikes a creature with a vicious display that inspires her allies. Allies who can see the Red Queen can use a reaction to Step or Stride to a space adjacent to an enemy, or to Strike.

g5zx6uy8n6fsqo49.name: Practiced Subterfuge
g5zx6uy8n6fsqo49.description: When the Red Queen makes a Deception check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint}, she compares her result to the Will DC of each enemy within 30 feet to determine the effect against that enemy. On a critical success, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to all melee attacks, not just melee attacks from the Red Queen, until the end of her next turn.

hdm1kiqmn8pnbde9.name: Red Ant Venom
hdm1kiqmn8pnbde9.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:40]

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[3d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[4d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[6d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3} (1 round)

lPBT22qKUXpUirSM.name: Shadow's Displeasure
lPBT22qKUXpUirSM.description: When Mariama has fewer than 150 Hit Points, her shadow pulls at her essence to show the Vesicant Egg's displeasure. She looks pained and confused. When below 50 Hit Points, she falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.

zhDB5m3eSThKE4Cc.name: Vesicated Shadow
zhDB5m3eSThKE4Cc.description: Mariama's shadow has become corrupted via the power of the Vesicant Egg. Her shredded shadow grants her some control over acid and shadows. She gains a +4 status bonus to resist acid and shadow effects.

nx9wkk5vhucfm861.name: Weird Astrology
nx9wkk5vhucfm861.description: Perhaps because of Mariama's quirky nature, she has received all the effects of the astrological evaluator. When she gains any of the clumsy, drained, enfeebled, or stupefied conditions, she reduces the value by 1. This means her Shadow's Displeasure doesn't affect her until she has fewer than 50 Hit Points, when she falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.

jpukmsf4fjjnmu64.name: Bind Destinies
jpukmsf4fjjnmu64.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect Mariama ties her fate with that of another creature within 30 feet. The creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:40] save. Regardless of the result of its save, the creature is temporarily immune for 1 day.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The two fates are bound. Whenever Mariama takes damage, the creature takes damage of the same type equal to half the damage Mariama took (@Check[fortitude|dc:37|basic]). Immunities, resistances, and weaknesses still apply as normal. The creature can attempt to sever the bond by spending an action, which has the concentrate trait, to attempt another @Check[will|dc:40] save. On a success, the bond is severed, and the effect ends. The bond also ends when Mariama falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or if she actively ends the effect herself as a free action.

Failure As success, but the creature takes damage equal to the full amount Mariama took. Severing the bond requires a 2-action activity, which has the concentrate trait.

Critical Failure As failure, but @Check[fortitude|dc:40|basic]. Severing the bond requires a 3-action activity, which has the concentrate trait.

F8cB9BOXSox2BLLk.name: Rupture Shadow
F8cB9BOXSox2BLLk.description:
Mariama can create immense blisters on a creature's shadow, which immediately burst, dealing @Damage[20d6[acid]] damage. She targets a creature within 60 feet that is casting a shadow, which must attempt a @Check[will|dc:37] save. Mariama can't use Rupture Shadow again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Rupture Shadow]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune for 1 day.

Success The target takes half damage. The bursting shadow deals @Damage[(5[splash])[acid]]{5 acid splash} damage to all creatures within 5 feet of the target.

Failure The target takes full damage, and the bursting shadow deals @Damage[(10[splash])[acid]]{10 acid splash} damage.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, the bursting shadow deals @Damage[(20[splash])[acid]]{20 acid splash} damage, and the target also takes @Damage[4d6[persistent,acid]] damage.

Wereant Disciple.name: Wereant Disciple
Wereant Disciple.description:
Insectile werecreatures, such as wereants, only come about in unusual circumstances, such as powerful curses from inhuman gods or transformative magic run amok. Wereants work together with a natural cohesion that's rare in other types of werecreatures. The wereants presented here are more powerful than most wereants, as they've been warped by the forces contained within the Vesicant Egg.

Some wereants have a religious zeal about training to protect their community and gladly give their lives for the hive.

35g2fh9fmfp3anxh.name: Gnawing Retort
35g2fh9fmfp3anxh.description:
Trigger A creature adjacent to the wereant critically misses the wereant with a melee Strike

Effect The wereant makes a mandibles Strike against the triggering creature.

fnmutsbmx35qyk3d.name: Hive Mind
fnmutsbmx35qyk3d.description: Wereants operate with a shared hive intelligence. While within telepathic range of at least one other wereant, a wereant disciple gains a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative checks, Perception checks, and saving throws against mental effects. If one wereant is aware of a combatant, all members of the hive mind within telepathic range are aware of it.

ky5U9PGQOWpgWpjC.name: Change Shape
ky5U9PGQOWpgWpjC.description:
The wereant changes into their humanoid, hybrid, or animal shape. Each shape has a specific, persistent appearance. A true wereant's natural form is their hybrid shape. In humanoid shape, they use their original humanoid size, lose their jaws and claw Strikes, and gain a melee fist Strike that deals bludgeoning damage equal to the slashing damage dealt by their mandibles. In animal shape, they take the form of a Medium giant ant, gain a climb Speed of 20 feet, gain Grab on their mandibles Strike, and lose their weapon Strikes.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

dLLXCoWbblalgqjW.name: Curse of the Wereant
dLLXCoWbblalgqjW.description:
This curse affects only humanoids

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:34].

On each full moon, the cursed creature must succeed at another Fortitude save or turn into a wereant until dawn.

The creature is under the GM's control and goes on a rampage for half the night before falling @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} until dawn.

grw0iihgx50xog7f.name: Flying Leap
grw0iihgx50xog7f.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The wereant disciple Flies and makes two Strikes against different targets at any point during that movement. These Strikes deal an additional 2d6 precision damage if the disciple is above the target. If the wereant began this action @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}, they remain hidden until after this ability's Strikes. Both attacks count toward the disciple's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after both Strikes.

o5kYgNvC941Wm7mn.name: Moon Frenzy
o5kYgNvC941Wm7mn.description:
When a full moon appears in the night sky, the wereant must enter hybrid form, can't Change Shape thereafter, becomes one size larger, increases its reach by 5 feet, and increases the damage of their mandibles Strike by 2.

When the moon sets or the sun rises, the werecreature returns to humanoid form and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} for [[/br 2d4 #Fatigued duration]]{2d4 hours}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.dRe8n1nBWMIXd8jh]{Effect: Moon Frenzy}

or2jprf57tejx70c.name: Staggering Blow
or2jprf57tejx70c.description: A creature damaged by the wereant disciple's carapace fist Strike must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:35] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2} on a critical failure). If the Strike is a critical hit, a creature that fails the save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Ta'apundo.name: Ta'apundo
Ta'apundo.description: The First World still holds the first rough draft of many creatures in the Material Plane, but it's hard to tell what sort of creature the ta'apundo was ever intended to be. Its bark poses significant danger to metallic objects, as it converts any metal touching it into wood as fibrous and as flexible as its own body. Capricious and skittish, ta'apundos make friends easily but consider anyone who wields or wears metal to be a hated enemy.

0jys5c0wzpevubc7.name: Greensight
0jys5c0wzpevubc7.description: Vegetation doesn't impair a ta'apundo's vision and doesn't provide a creature cover or concealment from a ta'apundo.

rcm4aifrs5kq8gp5.name: Lignification
rcm4aifrs5kq8gp5.description:
Trigger a non-cold iron metal object damages the ta'apundo

Effect The ta'apundo emits a jolt of magic into the object, transforming it into wood with an unlimited duration. A thrown weapon, ammunition, or other unattended item automatically transforms; the wielder of an attended object can resist this effect with a successful @Check[fortitude|dc:41] save. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} can end the effect. While a weapon is wood, the ta'apundo's resistance applies. Once transformed, a formerly metal item's Hardness and HP change to those of wood. This typically inflicts a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls made with metal weapons and a -2 circumstance penalty to AC for those wearing metal armor; the GM might determine a different penalty for a specific weapon or armor.

0u8ajvtxgwneihsd.name: Wood Resistance
0u8ajvtxgwneihsd.description: A ta'apundo has resistance 20 against wooden objects and unarmed attacks from creatures made mostly of wood (such as arboreals).

p1sbqkbkmmcbpn36.name: Branch Whip
p1sbqkbkmmcbpn36.description: The ta'apundo makes four branch Strikes against different targets, increasing its reach to 20 feet for these Strikes. These attacks count toward its multiple attack penalty, but this penalty doesn't increase until after all four attacks.

syfoe4g6n1h382lz.name: Woodland Stride
syfoe4g6n1h382lz.description: The ta'apundo ignores difficult and greater difficult terrain from foliage.

q7j7M7uBQFtqjcJj.name: Constrict
q7j7M7uBQFtqjcJj.description:
@Damage[5d10[bludgeoning]] damage, @Check[fortitude|dc:38|basic].

Before using Constrict, the ant can choose to smash one creature that it has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} against the ground. That creature uses the result one degree of success worse than its Fortitude save result against Constrict, but it is then no longer Grabbed or restrained by the ant.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Constrict]

y6osuhdlhe81ylrs.name: For the Queen!
y6osuhdlhe81ylrs.description: The red commander ant gives a pheromone signal to spur other ants into a fury. All ants within 30 feet who can smell this signal gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, reduce their frightened condition to 0, and are immune to the frightened condition for 1 minute.

lh29vfmsxvej89dh.name: Red Ant Venom
lh29vfmsxvej89dh.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:38]

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[3d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[4d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[6d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3} (1 round)

5zzsahgrf02p7stk.name: The Queen's Enemy
5zzsahgrf02p7stk.description: The red commander ant designates a single creature within 60 feet that it can see as its queen's enemy. All ants within 120 feet of the red commander ant deal an additional @Damage[1d8[bleed]] damage when they hit the target with mandibles Strikes. These effects last for 1 minute, or until the red commander ant uses The Queen's Enemy on a different creature.

Chromatic Ooze.name: Chromatic Ooze
Chromatic Ooze.description: Chromatic oozes result from the worst kind of alchemical mishaps: attempts to combine as many types of elemental damage as possible into a single alchemical substance. Although the source of these alchemical concatenations are as varied as the alchemists who attempt to distill them, one of the most common methods for creating them involves combining the essences of multiple types of chromatic dragons together using eldritch alchemical processes. When this type of experimentation goes dangerously wrong-as it often does-the result is a combination of terrible elemental power with the mindless destructive power of an ooze. A chromatic ooze is a rippling, seething substance that shifts through several different colors, but chemical reactions within the ooze can lock its energy and its color into a specific phase for a short time. Whether a chromatic ooze's destructive urges derive from the frustrated ingenuity of an alchemist creator or from the hunger of the chromatic dragons that so often constitute these oozes' forms, the best way to deal with a chromatic ooze is to stay out of its way.

this19hyfsm7kz6n.name: Caustic Aura
this19hyfsm7kz6n.description: 90 feet. The chromatic ooze emanates noxious chemicals into the environment. A creature that enters the aura or starts its turn within it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} unless it succeeds at a @Check[fortitude|dc:37] save. Creatures with the scent ability or a particularly heightened sense of smell are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}, or sickened 1 on a successful Fortitude save. Creatures in the aura can't recover from the sickened condition.

kq3mkk3i18txw9r3.name: Chromatic Shift
kq3mkk3i18txw9r3.description:
Trigger The chromatic ooze takes acid, cold, electricity, fire, or poison damage

Effect The chromatic ooze changes its color based on the triggering damage (to dark green, pale blue, dark blue, red, or light green, respectively) and gains resistance 20 to the triggering damage. If it already had resistance to another damage type from this ability, it loses the resistance to that damage type and gains weakness 20 to it. If it already had weakness to another damage type from this ability, it loses that weakness. After 1 minute, the chromatic ooze returns to its usual rippling, multicolored hue and loses the resistance and weakness from this ability.

gnshnz0bk049fhry.name: Motion Sense
gnshnz0bk049fhry.description: A chromatic ooze can sense nearby motion through vibration and air movement.

0qxeu9phhkhnav6x.name: Chromatic Slam
0qxeu9phhkhnav6x.description: The ooze's pseudopod Strikes deal an additional 2d10 damage of the same type it resists from its Chromatic Shift ability, if any.

9mxrf7zywmhqjtfd.name: Pseudopod Eruption
9mxrf7zywmhqjtfd.description: The chromatic ooze concentrates its mass into several pseudopods, increasing its reach to 30 feet until the end of its turn. It then Strikes at up to four different creatures within its reach. This counts as two attacks for the ooze's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after it makes all the attacks.

Alapolo.name: Alapolo
Alapolo.description: Short-lived, strange creatures called alapolos cling to the shadows in eerie moonlight, inviting others to dance. Although these "shadow dancers" aren't actively malevolent, they become petulant when others won't dance with them.

p6ariwootjhuhzph.name: Cloying Pull
p6ariwootjhuhzph.description:
Trigger A creature within the alapolo's reach attempts to move away from the alapolo

Effect The triggering creature must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:36] save or its movement ends before it leaves the alopolo's reach.

1wz1s7apbs3fx6gk.name: One with Shadows
1wz1s7apbs3fx6gk.description: The alapolo isn't affected by darkness, light, or shadow effects

48no5g4pib3t3ozt.name: Enticing Invitation
48no5g4pib3t3ozt.description:
The alapolo whispers an invitation to a creature within 30 feet. The creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:38] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and temporarily immune to all Enticing Invitations for 24 hours.

Success The target must spend 1 action on its next turn dancing in place.

Failure The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}. It is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the alapolo for 1 minute and can't attack the alapolo as long as it's fascinated. While fascinated, the target must spend 2 actions on each of its turns dancing in place.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3} and must spend 3 actions on each of its turns dancing in place.

uepcp41y26k3ec6q.name: Weighty Shadow
uepcp41y26k3ec6q.description:
Requirements The alapolo is adjacent to a target creature, or the GM determines the alapolo is adjacent to that creature's shadow

Effect The alapolo petulantly stomps on a target's shadow, making it incredibly heavy to drag around. The creature takes a -20-foot penalty to its Speeds for 1 minute. As normal, this penalty can't reduce a creature's Speed below 5 feet. Any creatures @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the alapolo due to its Enticing Invitation are freed from their fascination when the alapolo uses this ability, jarred by the graceless stomping.

om9njgwuavce9rkj.name: Formic Acid Spray
om9njgwuavce9rkj.description: The red guard ant sprays a @Template[cone|distance:15] of acid from its abdomen that deals @Damage[10d10[acid]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:34|basic|options:area-effect]). It can't use Formic Acid Spray again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Formic Acid Spray]]{1d4 rounds}.

93srntgpyj5pkt2v.name: Haul Away
93srntgpyj5pkt2v.description:
Requirements The red guard ant has a Huge or smaller creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}

Effect The ant Strides up to its full Speed, carrying the grabbed creature with it. It's encumbered if the grabbed creature is Large or larger.

nyyrw9no1m7cfik0.name: Pack Attack
nyyrw9no1m7cfik0.description: A red guard ant deals an additional 2d6 precision damage to any creature within reach of at least two of the ant's allies.

hfb023fkmu4js8af.description:

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[3d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[4d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} (1 round)

w571x6fpk5ala5vb.name: Swarming Flank
w571x6fpk5ala5vb.description: If at least three red guard ants have a creature within their reach, they flank the creature, even if they can't draw a line to each other that passes through opposite sides of the creature's space.

wt0f5nrj8qu0adwd.name: Darting Flight
wt0f5nrj8qu0adwd.description:

Trigger The ant is targeted with an attack by an attacker it can see

Effect The ant gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

73t0lwgb65wshnxy.name: Frenzy
73t0lwgb65wshnxy.description:
Frequency Once per day

Effect The alate ant enters a state of jittery agitation. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 3 rounds and can use the extra action only to Fly or Strike.

4u9dddirycdduzip.description: The alate ant sprays a cloud of pheromones in a @Template[cone|distance:15]. uhko7ohh9nl411li.description:

5oy93mlwu2qa2pxi.description: The wereant sentinel plants its feet in defiance of those who would move it. wv35tcrb819nmop2.name: Carapace Deflection
wv35tcrb819nmop2.description:
Trigger The ironclad annihilator beetle is targeted with an attack from an attacker it can see

Effect The ironclad annihilator pivots to place its tough carapace in the way of the attack, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to its AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, the ironclad annihilator can Step after the attack.

4rnpi3db0olu6yr4.name: Earthquake Stomp
4rnpi3db0olu6yr4.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The ironclad annihilator beetle stomps the ground. All creatures within a @Template[emanation|distance:30] must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:44] saving throw or fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} (stunned for 1 round on a critical failure).

upaegtrqpc4cwa5k.name: Oviposit
upaegtrqpc4cwa5k.description:
Requirements The ironclad annihilator beetle has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}

Effect The ironclad annihilator injects its ovipositor under the grabbed creature's skin. The creature takes @Damage[(4d6+20)[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:44|basic]). On a failed save, the beetle implants an egg, and the target creature takes @Damage[4d6[bleed]] that is unusually tenacious. The DC to stop the bleeding using Administer First Aid is @Check[medicine|dc:40|name:Administer First Aid|traits:action:administer-first-aid], and healing the creature to full Hit Points doesn't automatically stop the bleeding. If the target creature dies from this bleed damage, its body is destroyed and unrecoverable except with powerful magic such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YfJTXyVGzLhM6V8U]{Miracle} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish}, and an immature ironclad annihilator beetle (with statistics as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.MkupNnMKqDBElhhp]{Giant Stag Beetle}) bursts forth.

esk4sj88f3v3cv4o.name: Sunder Objects
esk4sj88f3v3cv4o.description: When an ironclad annihilator damages an item or structure, it deals an additional [[/r {2d10}]]{2d10 damage} to that item or structure.

iOkGanVQLy28fFnI.name: Golem Antimagic
iOkGanVQLy28fFnI.description:
Harmed by acid (@Damage[9d10[untyped]], @Damage[2d10[untyped]] from areas or persistent damage); healed by plant (area @Damage[2d10[healing]] HP); slowed by electricity

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.GolemAntimagic]

pjjx4azz3gsp6vh0.name: Repair Mode
pjjx4azz3gsp6vh0.description: When the golem is at 0 HP, it isn't destroyed. Instead, it enters repair mode, during which it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}, can't take reactions, and can take only the Self-Repair action. Once it has more than 30 HP, it can use any type of action and can use reactions, though it remains slowed 1 and can't take any reactions until the start of its next turn. If a critical hit with an adamantine weapon reduces the golem to 0 HP, or if such a weapon hits it while it's already at 0 HP, then the golem is destroyed.

t0rg3oycgmd415fs.name: Vulnerable to Dispelling and Shape Wood
t0rg3oycgmd415fs.description: The golem can be targeted by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ihbRf964JDXztcy3]{Disjunction}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.CXICME10TkEJxz0P]{Shape Wood}. If targeted by such a spell of 9th rank or higher, the golem has its resistance to physical damage lowered to 10 and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} if in repair mode) for [[/gmr 1d4 #Golem Vulnerability]]{1d4 rounds}. During this time, if the golem is reduced to 0 HP while already in repair mode, it is destroyed.

ggjs0w79v0sr9ab8.name: Destructive Strike
ggjs0w79v0sr9ab8.description: On a critical hit, the golem's staff Strike breaks the target's armor, if any, in addition to dealing damage to the target. If the target has a shield raised, the golem breaks the shield instead.

j9c0igc036qj9m4s.name: Inexorable March
j9c0igc036qj9m4s.description:
The golem Strides up to its Speed, pushing back each creature whose space it moves into and damaging them if they try to stop its movement. A creature can try to bar the way by attempting a @Check[fortitude|dc:43] save.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage and its armor takes no damage.

Success The golem halts its movement and cannot enter the creature's square.

Failure The resisting creature is damaged and its armor takes damage as if hit by the golem's staff.

broizkqu57k2yok4.name: Self-Repair
broizkqu57k2yok4.description: The golem repairs itself, regaining @Damage[30[healing]] Hit Points.

l3ib5p5v8pohydvm.name: Vent Splinters
l3ib5p5v8pohydvm.description: The golem vents a @Template[cone|distance:30] of fiery splinters from its internal forge. This deals @Damage[13d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in the cone (@Check[reflex|dc:38|basic|options:area-effect]). Creatures who fail the save also take @Damage[2d6[persistent,fire]] damage (@Damage[4d6[persistent,fire]] damage on a critical failure). The golem can't use Vent Splinters again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Vent Splinters]]{1d4 rounds}.

Wereant Poisoner.name: Wereant Poisoner
Wereant Poisoner.description:
Insectile werecreatures, such as wereants, only come about in unusual circumstances, such as powerful curses from inhuman gods or transformative magic run amok. Wereants work together with a natural cohesion that's rare in other types of werecreatures. The wereants presented here are more powerful than most wereants, as they've been warped by the forces contained within the Vesicant Egg.

When overwhelming force is inadvisable, a wereant hive sends a poison-dripping assassin for murderous work. These poisoners love to terrify those dying in agony from their toxins.

GyOwwVWZBfQazotf.name: Gnawing Retort
GyOwwVWZBfQazotf.description:
Trigger A creature adjacent to the wereant critically misses the wereant with a melee Strike

Effect The wereant makes a mandibles Strike against the triggering creature.

rie44HhT6OCUQnCT.name: Hive Mind
rie44HhT6OCUQnCT.description: Wereants operate with a shared hive intelligence. While within telepathic range of at least one other wereant, a wereant disciple gains a +2 circumstance bonus to initiative checks, Perception checks, and saving throws against mental effects. If one wereant is aware of a combatant, all members of the hive mind within telepathic range are aware of it.

3ggScBH5xJRksjF0.name: Change Shape
3ggScBH5xJRksjF0.description:
The wereant changes into their humanoid, hybrid, or animal shape. Each shape has a specific, persistent appearance. A true wereant's natural form is their hybrid shape. In humanoid shape, they use their original humanoid size, lose their jaws and claw Strikes, and gain a melee fist Strike that deals bludgeoning damage equal to the slashing damage dealt by their mandibles. In animal shape, they take the form of a Medium giant ant, gain a climb Speed of 20 feet, gain Grab on their mandibles Strike, and lose their weapon Strikes.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

vCBcq5X4CA3AdJAt.name: Curse of the Wereant
vCBcq5X4CA3AdJAt.description:
This curse affects only humanoids

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:34].

On each full moon, the cursed creature must succeed at another Fortitude save or turn into a wereant until dawn.

The creature is under the GM's control and goes on a rampage for half the night before falling @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} until dawn.

8nh48znq0ytxo14q.name: Envenomed Weapons
8nh48znq0ytxo14q.description: Weapons the wereant poisoner holds deal an additional @Damage[2d6[persistent,poison]] as poison seeps from the wereant's hands onto the weapon. Weapons cease to deal this persistent poison damage once the wereant lets them go. The kukri Strikes above include this persistent poison damage.

c1Uo44lQWgOcY82g.name: Moon Frenzy
c1Uo44lQWgOcY82g.description:
When a full moon appears in the night sky, the wereant must enter hybrid form, can't Change Shape thereafter, becomes one size larger, increases its reach by 5 feet, and increases the damage of their mandibles Strike by 2.

When the moon sets or the sun rises, the werecreature returns to humanoid form and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} for [[/br 2d4 #Fatigued duration]]{2d4 hours}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.dRe8n1nBWMIXd8jh]{Effect: Moon Frenzy}

67nta5e94jefe99z.name: Poisonous Flurry
67nta5e94jefe99z.description: The wereant poisoner makes two kukri Strikes and a mandibles Strike in any order.

o60iwfva1geln42u.name: Vitriolic Strikes
o60iwfva1geln42u.description: If the wereant critically hits a creature with a melee Strike, that creature can't recover from persistent poison damage for 1 round.

Aspect of Insects.name: Aspect of Insects
Aspect of Insects.description: Fearsome centipede-like creatures, mukradis are three-headed predators with a devastating array of breath weapons. A Darklands version of the mukradi is rumored to exist. It's said these variant mukradis have black scales, and all of their heads spew a black, acidic goo that animates before being reabsorbed by the mukradis.

4sbtk4cjpySTiUck.name: Key Weakness
4sbtk4cjpySTiUck.description: The King of Biting Ants has long used his force of will to keep his insectile form under control. It has a weakness to arcane spells and occult spells.

GVNTgGaXcebR64nT.name: Partitioned Anatomy
GVNTgGaXcebR64nT.description:
Trigger The Aspect of Insects would be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned}.

Effect The Aspect of Insects confines the debilitating effect to a certain portion of its nervous system, ignoring the effect but causing a maw of its choice to go dormant for the effect's duration. That maw can't be used for a Strike or Breath Weapon during that time. This ability can't be used if all the Aspect of Insects' heads are dormant.

7JcMtxcKSyHdqEQX.name: Spitting Rage
7JcMtxcKSyHdqEQX.description:
Trigger A creature scores a critical hit on the Aspect of Insects.

Effect The Aspect of Insects' Breath Weapon recharges. It can use its Breath Weapon immediately as part of this reaction. It can't use this reaction again until it recharges its Breath Weapon naturally.

TwSJCzLZ4KcJKaWT.name: Breath Weapon
TwSJCzLZ4KcJKaWT.description:
The Aspect of Insects breathes a blast of energy from one of its three heads; each creature in the area must attempt a basic Reflex save.

The Aspect of Insects can't use Breath Weapon again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 rounds}.

  • Acid Maw (acid) @Template[line|distance:60|width:10]{10-Foot-Wide, 60-Foot Line} of acid dealing @Damage[16d8[acid]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:42|basic|traits:acid|options:area-effect] save).
  • Flame Maw (fire) @Template[cone|distance:60] of fire dealing @Damage[16d8[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:42|basic|traits:fire|options:area-effect] save).
  • Shock Maw (electricity) @Template[line|distance:120] of electricity dealing @Damage[16d8[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:42|basic|traits:electricity|options:area-effect] save).

MCe44ome2cf0lQ8W.name: Pull Apart
MCe44ome2cf0lQ8W.description: The Aspect of Insects makes two Strikes with different maws against the same target. If both hit, the target takes an extra @Damage[(2d12+13)[slashing]] damage, with a @Check[fortitude|dc:42|basic] save. On a critical failure, the creature is torn to pieces and dies. The Aspect of Insects' multiple attack penalty increases only after all the attacks are made.

hk3y1r8nU2o8QA4C.name: Thrash
hk3y1r8nU2o8QA4C.description: The Aspect of Insects Strikes once against each creature in its reach. It can Strike up to once with each maw, once with its tail lash, and any number of times with its legs. Each attack takes a -2 circumstance penalty and counts toward the Aspect of Insects' multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks are made.

js6y1tz0yizjubtu.name: Cling
js6y1tz0yizjubtu.description:
Trigger A creature leaves the swarm's space

Effect The swarm loses [[/r 2d8]]{2d8 HP} as ants cling to the creature and continue biting, dealing @Damage[7d8[persistent,piercing]] damage. High winds or immersion in water reduces the DC of the flat check to end this persistent damage to 5. Any area damage dealt to the creature destroys these clinging ants.

uc4njwket4raq8i9.name: Inexorable
uc4njwket4raq8i9.description: The apocalypse ant swarm recovers from the slowed and stunned conditions at the end of its turn. It's immune to penalties to its Speeds and ignores difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain.

e2sotcu0vxd8kydj.name: Swarming Bites
e2sotcu0vxd8kydj.description: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes @Damage[7d8[piercing]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:39|basic]). A creature that fails its save against Swarming Bites becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round (1 minute on a critical failure). If the creature attempts a concentrate or manipulate action while affected, it must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] or the action is lost; roll the check after spending the action, but before any effects are applied.

Crawling Slurry.name: Crawling Slurry
Crawling Slurry.description: Acid damage can scar stone and reduce flesh to pitted chunks, but some organic compounds are resistant to acid and respond by combining into a mass of roiling, living slurry. These scarred clumps hunger to consume anything they can sense. They move with quick, darting contractions that surprise those used to facing slow-moving oozes.

r7j0g2jiv48stp4g.name: Motion Sense
r7j0g2jiv48stp4g.description: A crawling slurry can sense nearby motion through vibration and air movement.

b3qyz6sezwbmg0li.name: Splatter
b3qyz6sezwbmg0li.description:
Trigger The crawling slurry takes bludgeoning damage from a creature it can sense within 10 feet

Effect The crawling slurry ejects a splash of acid onto the creature, dealing acid damage equal to the bludgeoning damage dealt to the crawling slurry (@Check[reflex|dc:37|basic]).

brj4p8cn1hcxtnzr.name: Crawling Slurry Acid
brj4p8cn1hcxtnzr.description: A crawling slurry's acid damages metals and organic materials but not stone.

Hnu8sQjkICIDsSGc.name: Engulf
Hnu8sQjkICIDsSGc.description:
@Check[reflex|dc:37] save, @Damage[5d10[acid]] damage, [[/act escape dc=37]], Rupture 20. A crawling slurry regains @Damage[30[healing]] Hit Points if a living creature it is engulfing dies.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Engulf]

Aspect of Hunger.name: Aspect of Hunger
Aspect of Hunger.description:
Among the most dangerous cave worms are the fiery crimson worms. In addition to being even larger than azure or purple worms, the crimson worm has a penchant for burrowing through volcanic regions that, over the generations, have infused it with a supernatural link to the Elemental Plane of Fire. The molten heart of an active volcano is an attractive lair for a crimson worm, as are the sprawling fields of bubbling magma found in the deepest reaches of the Darklands. Legends from ancient peoples, precursor dwarven societies, and colonists of the Elemental Planes populated moats of lava with crimson worms likely have some basis in truth, although the methods such ancients used to keep these "moat worms" contained and prevented them from chewing their way through fortress foundations must have been significant.

Crimson worms sometimes frequent areas on the surface where volcanism creates hot springs or other geothermal features, but even then they prefer to spend most of their time burrowing through the ground in their never-ending search for sustenance. Surface lands claimed by crimson worms are notable for the mound-shaped burrows these creatures leave behind as they dig.

Cave worms are gigantic scavengers that bore through the depths of the world, eating whatever material they find. Named for their distinctive colorations, these worms are ravenous and display overwhelming destructive capabilities. Cave worms of different colors and abilities lurk in the more remote corners of the world-tales speak of white worms that dwell within immense glaciers or icebergs and gray worms that burrow through the boneyards of long-forgotten ruins, to name a few.

tphsLfLbrYV16pth.name: Inexorable
tphsLfLbrYV16pth.description: The Aspect of Hunger recovers from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} conditions at the end of its turn. It's also immune to penalties to its Speeds and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} condition, and it ignores difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain.

oH2dTqxjbFv3VNfs.name: Key Weakness
oH2dTqxjbFv3VNfs.description: The Aspect of Hunger is foiled by the bounty of natural magic. It has a weakness to divine spells and primal spells.

Y5momV4CWpuw5vhk.name: Shake It Off
Y5momV4CWpuw5vhk.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger The Aspect of Hunger would be affected by a condition or adverse effect (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dN8QBNuTiaBHCKUe]{Cursed Metamorphosis})

Effect The Aspect of Hunger negates the triggering condition or effect. Effects from artifacts, deities, or a similarly powerful source can't be avoided in this way.

t1G2FbWy88tYUk7w.name: Aspect of Hunger Venom
t1G2FbWy88tYUk7w.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:41]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage and drained 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} (1 round).

hdZW9dGdp8kUzUjv.name: Breath Weapon
hdZW9dGdp8kUzUjv.description:
The Aspect of Hunger breathes a blast of hunger in a @Template[cone|distance:60] that deals @Damage[18d6[mental]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in the area (@Check[reflex|dc:41|basic|options:area-effect] save).

It can't use Breath Weapon again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 rounds}.

5aIyCd7vJWNPQTe3.name: Essence of Hunger
5aIyCd7vJWNPQTe3.description: The Aspect of Hunger doesn't have the fire trait, immunity to fire, weakness to cold, or fire healing. It instead has immunity to mental effects, and its attacks deal mental damage instead of fire damage.

fifv91vxtwlIpzXx.name: Fast Swallow
fifv91vxtwlIpzXx.description:
Trigger The Aspect of Hunger @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabs} a creature

Effect The Aspect of Hunger uses Swallow Whole.

NBXY2jJ5QKUZlI60.name: Rock Tunneler
NBXY2jJ5QKUZlI60.description: The Aspect of Hunger can burrow through solid stone at a Speed of 20 feet. It can leave a tunnel if it desires, and it usually does.

8VCoSCtEbUqhtmnI.name: Swallow Whole
8VCoSCtEbUqhtmnI.description:
Huge, @Damage[(3d10+10)[bludgeoning],2d6[mental]]{3d10+10 bludgeoning damage plus 2d6 mental damage}, Rupture 36

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]

D1ZUrE1107HIW39r.name: Thrash
D1ZUrE1107HIW39r.description: The Aspect of Hunger makes a Strike once against each creature in its reach. It can Strike up to once with its jaws, up to once with its stinger, and any number of times with its body. Each attack counts toward the Aspect of Hunger's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after it makes all the attacks.

xwlrc0y7m4gbb0aj.name: Extra Reaction
xwlrc0y7m4gbb0aj.description: A thorn guardian gains an additional reaction each turn but can use this extra reaction only to Retaliate.

sfko8ztlbbitvfik.name: Retaliate
sfko8ztlbbitvfik.description:
Trigger A creature within the thorn guardian's reach attacks the guardian's ward

Effect The thorn guardian makes a briar Strike against the triggering creature. If it hits, it deals an additional @Damage[2d6[bleed]].

q5q18a8pjacvh8kh.name: Bond with Ward
q5q18a8pjacvh8kh.description:
Requirements The thorn guardian is adjacent to its ward

Effect The thorn guardian enters its ward's space and encases the creature. This doesn't interfere with its ward's senses or actions. The thorn guardian occupies the same space as its ward and moves with its ward.

While worn, the thorn guardian establishes a constant @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.d7Lwx6KAs47MtF0q]{Share Life} effect with its ward. Attacks that target the thorn guardian target the ward instead but use the higher AC or saving throw values between the thorn guardian and the ward. Area effects apply to both the thorn guardian and the ward, as normal for an area effect.

y9n6o01btwmvgxlj.name: Fly Free
y9n6o01btwmvgxlj.description:
Requirements The thorn guardian is Bonded with its Ward

Effect The thorn guardian removes itself from the ward and enters an adjacent space.

0jjczv5v33ef456x.name: Interpose
0jjczv5v33ef456x.description:
Requirements The thorn guardian is Bonded with or adjacent to its ward

Effect The thorn guardian interposes itself between the ward and its foes, granting its ward a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of the thorn guardian's next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.7PjBr9LsVB0Jjzyu]{Effect: Interpose}

XzWllQOTD8ZvW9Oi.name: Shadow's Displeasure
XzWllQOTD8ZvW9Oi.description: When Anchor Root has fewer than 150 Hit Points, her shadow pulls at her essence to show the Vesicant Egg's displeasure. She looks pained and confused, and she becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until healed to 150 Hit Points or more. These conditions increase to 2 when below 100 Hit Points. When below 50 Hit Points, she falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.

Nv8YtW2xPTnP0KrJ.name: Vesicated Shadow
Nv8YtW2xPTnP0KrJ.description: Anchor Root's shadow has become corrupted via the power of the Vesicant Egg. Her shredded shadow grants her some control over acid and shadows. She gains a +4 status bonus to resist acid and shadow effects.

O7Nkcu4MCIufyEcJ.name: Rupture Shadow
O7Nkcu4MCIufyEcJ.description:
Anchor Root can create immense blisters on a creature's shadow, which immediately burst, dealing @Damage[20d6[acid]] damage. She targets a creature within 60 feet that is casting a shadow, which must attempt a @Check[will|dc:37] save. Anchor Root can't use Rupture Shadow again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Rupture Shadow]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune for 1 day.

Success The target takes half damage. The bursting shadow deals @Damage[(5[splash])[acid]]{5 acid splash} damage to all creatures within 5 feet of the target.

Failure The target takes full damage, and the bursting shadow deals @Damage[(10[splash])[acid]]{10 acid splash} damage.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, the bursting shadow deals @Damage[(20[splash])[acid]]{20 acid splash} damage, and the target also takes @Damage[4d6[persistent,acid]] damage.

IHURJGCRE1ctHuEN.name: Shadow's Displeasure
IHURJGCRE1ctHuEN.description: When Koride has fewer than 150 Hit Points, her shadow pulls at her essence to show the Vesicant Egg's displeasure. She looks pained and confused, and she becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until healed to 150 Hit Points or more. These conditions increase to 2 when below 100 Hit Points. When below 50 Hit Points, she falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}.

XxMTTN80Z84ZwYsz.name: Vesicated Shadow
XxMTTN80Z84ZwYsz.description: Koride's shadow has become corrupted via the power of the Vesicant Egg. Her shredded shadow grants her some control over acid and shadows. She gains a +4 status bonus to resist acid and shadow effects.

aKVxowf3fUlcmJuc.description:
Koride can create immense blisters on a creature's shadow, which immediately burst, dealing @Damage[20d6[acid]] damage. She targets a creature within 60 feet that is casting a shadow, which must attempt a @Check[will|dc:37] save. Koride can't use Rupture Shadow again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Rupture Shadow]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune for 1 day.

Success The target takes half damage. The bursting shadow deals @Damage[(5[splash])[acid]]{5 acid splash} damage to all creatures within 5 feet of the target.
